focus.product: Palm-oil mill machinery and wear parts (screw-press worms, double-worm presses, ripple mills, press and digester spares)
focus.why: Medan and Deli Serdang firms already hold TKDN for palm ripple mills and double-worm presses (57-66%) and alloy press worms (88.16%). Indonesia imported US$215.7M (847920) and US$258.8M (847990) in 2025. PTPN IV mills and KEK Sei Mangkei (29 firms, Rp33.15T invested by 2026) are the buyers on the doorstep.

also.product: Aluminium-smelter consumable castings for Inalum (anode yokes, stubs, bottom strippers)
also.why: PT Asia Raya Foundry holds TKDN 90.05% (anode yoke) and 94.22% (bottom stripper); Inalum's Kuala Tanjung smelter (250,000 t/yr) is Indonesia's only aluminium smelter to end-2021. No clean HS line (probably within 7325.99).

also.product: Brass propellers and stern gear for fishing and coastal boats
also.why: CV Putra Karya Logam Sukses (Asahan) holds TKDN 72.74-83.41% for 44-72 inch 4-blade brass propellers. 3D-printed casting patterns plus CNC finishing would raise accuracy. National imports 2025: 848710 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026); 848310 US$189.4M.

focus.product: Oilfield wellhead, downhole and pipeline components for the Rokan block (Duri-Dumai belt)
focus.why: Two Bathin Solapan (Duri) firms hold TKDN for wellhead and Xmas-tree parts, heat-treated couplings and crossovers (19-50%) and pipeline sleeves (58-68%). Riau has the most KBLI 25920 machining firms of the four provinces in SIINas (10). Pertamina Hulu Rokan runs Rokan (US$3.05B revenue, 2024). Indonesia imported US$242.7M (843143) and US$185.7M (848190) in 2025.

also.product: Pulp and paper machine spare parts (rolls, shafts, refiner, screen and pump parts) for RAPP Kerinci and IKPP Perawang
also.why: APRIL's Kerinci mill can make 2.8 Mt pulp and 1.15 Mt paper a year; IKPP's Perawang mill anchors 3.1 Mt/yr group pulp capacity (2021). No local TKDN maker of paper-machine parts was found. National imports 2025: 843991 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026); 843999 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026).

also.product: Palm-oil mill wear parts and boiler spares
also.why: Palm-oil processing is Riau's official industri unggulan (Permenperin 131/2010) and Riau sets 2026 sectoral wages for the CPO industry. No Riau-based TKDN maker of mill parts was found; national imports 2025: 847990 US$258.8M; 840290 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026).

focus.product: Cement-plant wear and spare parts (mill and crusher liners, grinding media, kiln and cooler parts) for Semen Padang
focus.why: Semen Padang runs five Indarung plants plus one in Dumai (8.9 Mt/yr, end-2020) and already holds TKDN for kiln shells (61.80% with local plate). Its parent SIG localised Rp652bn of spare parts in 2023. Indonesia imported US$288.1M of 847490 in 2025. The local metal base is thin (SIINas: 26 metal and machinery firms, no foundry), so this needs a foundry-plus-CNC build-up.

also.product: Small farm machines and alsintan spare parts (threshers, tillers, shellers, wear parts)
also.why: Dharmasraya had 347 metal IKM units (2019) and a DAK-built metal IKM centre (2018-19) for alsintan repair and parts that were brought in from outside; CV Citra Dragon Teknik (Padang Pariaman) builds threshers and tillers at TKDN 40%. National imports 2025: 843390 US$23.6M (88% China); 843290 US$8.4M.

also.product: Forged hand tools and blades from the Sungai Pua iron and brass craft (Agam)
also.why: Sungai Pua is known for iron and brass craftsmen (Wikipedia). CNC or laser blanking and controlled heat treatment could lift quality. No firm-level or output data found. National imports 2025: 8201 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026); 8211 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026).

focus.product: Essential-oil distillers and small agro-processing machines
focus.why: Essential oils and fish processing are Aceh's official industri unggulan (Permenperin 130/2010). PT Sang General Industri (Aceh Besar) already holds TKDN 34-40% for SS304 essential-oil distillers, cocoa and threshing machines. Aceh's registered metal base is tiny (SIINas: 10 metal and machinery firms), so a fabrication-plus-CNC machinery niche is the realistic start. National imports 2025: 841940 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026).

also.product: Fishing-boat propellers, shafts and stern gear
also.why: Fish and seafood processing is Aceh's other official priority (Permenperin 130/2010). The nearest certified propeller maker is in Asahan, Sumatera Utara (TKDN 72.74-83.41%). 3D-printed patterns plus CNC finishing suit small batches. National imports 2025: 848710 not retrieved (Comtrade quota, 16 Oct 2026).

also.product: Maintenance spares for KEK Arun Lhokseumawe gas, fertiliser and petrochemical plants (pump, valve and compressor parts)
also.why: KEK Arun (PP 5/2017) targets energy, petrochemicals, agro-industry, logistics and kraft paper; PIM runs urea (570,000 t/yr), ammonia and NPK plants; PT Wira Cipta Perkasa (Aceh Utara) packages gas compressors. National imports 2025: 841391 US$300.0M; 848190 US$185.7M.
